Only methods declared in sugar-ssh-server/src, or inherited from a parent declared there, are listed. A type that extends a class outside that tree, such as \RuntimeException, does not show the methods of that class.

SugarCraft\SshServer

CancellationException final class

MethodSummary
__construct(string $reason = '')The optional reason rides the fixed text as context cancelled: <reason> — a bare throw used to be the only shape this channel could carry. Context::cancel() hands a supplied Throwable through to err() verbatim, so cancel(new CancellationException('hangup received')) is the blessed way to attach a why without defining a class of your own.

Context final class

Immutable context object carrying cancellation, deadlines, and key-value metadata across the middleware chain.

MethodSummary
static background(): selfRoot context — never done, no values, not cancelable.
withValue(string $k, mixed $v): selfAttach a key-value pair and return a new derived Context.
withDeadline(\DateTimeImmutable $deadline): selfReturn a new derived Context with the given deadline.
withCancelable(): selfReturn a new derived Context with an active cancellation signal.
cancel(?\Throwable $reason = null): boolMark this Context (and all derived contexts) as cancelled.
done(): boolReturns true when this Context — or any ancestor it was derived from — has been cancelled, or when a deadline in the chain has expired.
err(): ?\ThrowableReturns the cancellation or deadline error, or null if not done.
deadline(): ?\DateTimeImmutableThe earliest deadline in this context's chain, or null when no node carries one.
value(string $k): mixedLook up a value by key, walking the parent chain.

DeadlineExceededException final class

MethodSummary
__construct(string $reason = '')The optional reason rides the fixed text as context deadline exceeded: <reason>. With no reason the message is the plain fixed string, so anything matching on it today keeps matching.

Server final class

SSH session entry point.

MethodSummary
static new(): self
use(Middleware $m): selfAppend a middleware to the stack.
withMiddleware(Middleware ...$ms): selfAppend several middlewares at once, in order, clone-and-return — the varargs spelling of use(), mirroring the Go option-list form.
onSession(callable $fn): selfAppend a session hook to the stack without writing a class.
withTransport(Transport $t): selfOverride the active transport. Defaults to InProcessTransport when not called.
transport(): Transport
withLocale(string $code): selfArm a catalogue locale for the notices this server renders.
withKeepalive(int $intervalSeconds = 60): selfArm an idle keepalive beat for sessions this server serves.
serve(?Session $session = null, ?Context $ctx = null): intBuild the Session from the current environment (or use the injected one) and ask the active transport to run the middleware chain. Returns when the chain finishes — for a terminal subprocess (Spawn / BubbleTea) that's when the inner process exits or the SSH client disconnects.
static resolveStatus(Session $session): intThe one answer to 'what code does this session leave behind?'.

Per-connection session metadata exposed to middleware.

MethodSummary
__construct(public readonly string $user = '', public readonly string $clientHost = '', public readonly int $clientPort = 0, public readonly string $serverHost = '', public readonly int $serverPort = 0, public readonly string $term = 'xterm-256color', public readonly int $cols = self::DEFAULT_COLS, public readonly int $rows = self::DEFAULT_ROWS, public readonly ?string $tty = null, public readonly ?string $command = null, public readonly string $lang = 'C.UTF-8', public readonly ?string $sessionId = null, public readonly ?string $authMethod = null, public readonly ?string $keyFingerprint = null, public readonly ?string $clientVersion = null, public readonly ?string $serverVersion = null)

static auto(): selfResolve the sink from the deployment environment: the configured SSH_SERVER_LOG file when present, stderr otherwise. Prefer this over new Logger() in boot code so the resolution is visible at the call site.

SugarCraft\SshServer\Transport

ChildSpawner interface

Marker interface for transports that can spawn a child process inside a controlled PTY and pump bytes on its behalf.

MethodSummary
runChild(Session $session, array $cmd, ?array $env = null): intSpawn $cmd inside a fresh PTY and pump bytes between the supervisor's STDIN/STDOUT and the master fd until the child exits, returns the exit code.
signalChild(int $signal): voidForward a signal to the live child process.

DispatchesMiddlewareStack trait

Shared middleware-stack walk owning the library's single promise settle point.

HostSshdTransport final class

Legacy transport — runs the middleware stack directly in the supervisor process. STDIN/STDOUT are the slave side of sshd's PTY (sshd allocated it for the SSH session and exposed it via the inherited file descriptors).

MethodSummary
run(Context $ctx, Session $session, array $stack): int

InProcessTransport final class

Default transport — allocates a sugar-pty master/slave pair via the injected (or factory-resolved) PtySystem, spawns the user's cmd as a subprocess with controllingTerminal: true, and pumps bytes between the supervisor's STDIN/STDOUT and the PTY master via PosixPump.

MethodSummary
__construct(?PtySystem $system = null)
withSizeProvider(callable $provider): selfReturns a clone of this transport with the given size provider — used by SIGWINCH forwarding to query the host's PTY winsize. Production code rarely needs to call this.
armKeepalive(int $intervalSeconds): voidBegin emitting the keepalive beat: at most one per transport, replaced (not stacked) by later calls.
setKeepaliveCallback(callable $callback): voidRegister a callback to be invoked in the pump loop whenever stream_select reports no ready streams (idle timeout).
setChannelHandler(ChannelHandler $handler): voidSet the channel handler for dispatching SSH channel messages.
pty(): MasterPtyReturns the active master PTY for the current session. Valid only while a session is actively being pumped — callers must not store the reference across pump-loop boundaries. Its single legitimate caller in this library is the armed keepalive beat (armKeepalive()); the accessor stays public so custom pump callbacks registered via setKeepaliveCallback() can reach the master too.
run(Context $ctx, Session $session, array $stack): int
runChild(Session $session, array $cmd, ?array $env = null, $stdin = null, $stdout = null, ?Context $ctx = null): intSpawn $cmd as a subprocess inside a fresh PTY and pump bytes between the caller's STDIN/STDOUT (or the supervisor's process stdio if those are null) and the PTY master until the child exits or one of the stdio streams hits EOF.
signalChild(int $signal): void
